title: Aloria SMP
description: Aloria smp is a vanilla plus server focused on our community, economy and socializing. we keep close to vanilla and only add/tweak aspects of the game to make things more fun and freshened up.
body:
Aloria is a whitelisted proximity voice chat SMP built around one idea: players should actually see and interact with each other.
Running into new people and familiar faces is easy, and conversations happen naturally just by walking past someone.

The server focuses on community, economy, and social interaction, creating a more immersive multiplayer experience. We stay close to vanilla Minecraft, only adding or tweaking features to keep the game feeling fresh and fun without changing its core.

# **🎤 Proximity Voice Chat**

Proximity voice chat adds a lot to our experience.
There’s no need to hop into a Discord call or stop to type, you can just talk naturally as you play. It completely changes how our server feels.

# **💰 Economy**

Every trade on Aloria is between real players.
There are no fake prices just supply, demand, and the players choice. Whether you want to run a shop, supply a business, or live out in the wild, your time and effort has real value here.

# **🚫 No Commands**

There are no commands not even /tpa, /claim, /home or /sit.
Everything is done through real gameplay, designed to feel as natural and intuitive as possible.
